results.text: Evaluation of the protective effect of N-acetylcysteine on contrast media nephropathy. Intravenous contrast agents can cause acute decline in kidney function, especially in patients with risk factors.

A potential protective factor against renal Ischemia-reperfusion damage: D-carvone. Ischemia-reperfusion (IR) injury-induced renal failure is a major cause of death and morbidity. Unfortunately, there is currently no proven protective therapy. The aim of the study is to investigate the protective effect of D-carvone against the renal ischemia-reperfusion (RIR) injury.
